notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description only; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited after saving, but not before saving.
REF-BM-04: Editing title, description, tags, and note is supported, but URL editing is missing.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and the existing item is highlighted, but the user is not taken into editing it.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are offered as a fixed, section-scoped suggestion list rather than autocomplete driven by entered text.
REF-BM-14: No #tag query parsing exists.
REF-BM-15: Search is a plain substring check with no Boolean operators, grouping, or operator-literal rules.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact phrases.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No action can target the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Results are hard-coded to creation-date descending; no selectable sort key is implemented.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is escaped and shown as plain text rather than rendered.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or reusable saved filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
